Created by 韩晓盼, last modified on 八月 02, 2024

# 1. 需求概述

  [https://pingcode.yasdb.com/pjm/items/66192bcffd997db58ad8a622](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/pjm/items/66192bcffd997db58ad8a622)    ?    
  #YDBRD-26296 支持information_schema约束相关视图

  


支持特定的视图&系统表 

CHECK_CONSTRAINTS 

REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS 

TABLE_CONSTRAINTS 

KEY_COLUMN_USAGE

  


# 2. 友商的实现情况

|特性|友商|实现情况（mysql5.7）|实现情况（mysql8.0）|备注|
|:---|:---|:---|---|---|
|CHECK_CONSTRAINTS|mysql|提供表和列CHECK 约束信息。,当前数据库的每个CHECK 约束在该视图中占一行。该视图返回当前用户对其拥有权限的对象的有关信息。,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396e27a1ad9a3311dc9569/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..3dUfHUhCRJLdhPaaT4n34efPNDBz4e6NJ1XtOW1bpmg),  
|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396e288970c2af4f5216f7/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..3dUfHUhCRJLdhPaaT4n34efPNDBz4e6NJ1XtOW1bpmg)|mysql5.7没有这个系统表；,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396e28a1ad9a3311dc956a/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..3dUfHUhCRJLdhPaaT4n34efPNDBz4e6NJ1XtOW1bpmg),mysql8.0开始使用该系统表。,MySQL 8.0.16 于 2019 年 4 月 25 日发布，终于带来了我们期待已久的 CHECK 约束功能，而且对于所有的存储引擎都有效。CREATE TABLE 语句允许以下形式的 CHECK 约束语法，可以指定列级约束和表级约束：,[CONSTRAINT [symbol]] CHECK (expr) [[NOT] ENFORCED]    
,  
,  
|
|REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS|mysql|提供有关外键的信息，可对比查看  INNODB_SYS_FOREIGN。,只有那些当前用户具有其引用表上写权限（作为拥有者或具有某些除    `SELECT`    之外的特权）的约束才会被显示。,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396e288970c2af4f5216f8/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..3dUfHUhCRJLdhPaaT4n34efPNDBz4e6NJ1XtOW1bpmg),  
|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396e28a1ad9a3311dc956b/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..3dUfHUhCRJLdhPaaT4n34efPNDBz4e6NJ1XtOW1bpmg)|TABLE_NAME与TABLE_CONSTRAINTS表中的值相同|
|TABLE_CONSTRAINTS|mysql|提供哪个表具有约束信息。,当前用户拥有表或者是当前用户在表上具有某种除    `SELECT`    之外的特权。,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396e288970c2af4f5216f9/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..3dUfHUhCRJLdhPaaT4n34efPNDBz4e6NJ1XtOW1bpmg)|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396e288970c2af4f5216fa/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..3dUfHUhCRJLdhPaaT4n34efPNDBz4e6NJ1XtOW1bpmg)|  `字段CONSTRAINT_TYPE：UNIQUE`      `PRIMARY KEY`      `FOREIGN KEY`      `CHECK`  |
|KEY_COLUMN_USAGE|mysql|提供  哪些键列具有约束条件，可对比查看INNODB_SYS_FOREIGN_COLS。,![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396e288970c2af4f5216fc/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..3dUfHUhCRJLdhPaaT4n34efPNDBz4e6NJ1XtOW1bpmg)|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396e28a1ad9a3311dc956d/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..3dUfHUhCRJLdhPaaT4n34efPNDBz4e6NJ1XtOW1bpmg)|  
|

|**CHECK_CONSTRAINTS**|select * from information_schema.  CHECK_CONSTRAINTS  ;,select * from information_schema.CHECK_CONSTRAINTS where CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = 'hanxp';,--创建check,CREATE TABLE t1    
  (    
  c1 INT CHECK (c1 > 10),    
  c2 INT ,    
  c3 INT CHECK (c3 < 100),    
  CONSTRAINT c2_positive CHECK (c2 > 0),    
  CHECK (c1 > c3)    
  );,select * from information_schema.CHECK_CONSTRAINTS where CONSTRAINT_SCHEMA = 'hanxp';,--删除check，系统表数据被清除,drop table t1;,

|MATCH_OPTION可选值,--NONE（默认值）,--PARTIAL（部分匹配）,--FULL（完全匹配）,  
|  [MySQL :: MySQL 5.7 Reference Manual :: 1.6.3.2 FOREIGN KEY Constraints](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/5.7/en/constraint-foreign-key.html)  |没啥实际效果？避免使用，所以PARTIAL、FULL有必要做吗？|
|UPDATE_RULE/DELETE_RULE可选值,--RESTRICT,--NO ACTION,--CASCADE,--SET NULL,--SET DEFAULT|--建约束,drop table t1;,drop table t2;,CREATE     TABLE   t1   (   s1   INT  ,   s2   INT  ,   s3   INT  ,     PRIMARY     KEY  (  s3  )     )     ENGINE  =  InnoDB  ;   ,CREATE     TABLE   t2   (   s1   INT  ,   s2   INT  ,   s3   INT  ,     KEY  (  s3  )     )     ENGINE  =  InnoDB  ;,--更改约束（混合使用）,alter table t2 add constraint Reference_1 foreign key(s2) references t1(s3) on delete RESTRICT on update NO ACTION;,--查询,select * from information_schema.  REFERENTIAL_CONSTRAINTS  ;,SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.INNODB_SYS_FOREIGN\G|![](https://pingcode.yasdb.com/atlas/files/public/67396e29a1ad9a3311dc9575/origin-url?token=eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..3dUfHUhCRJLdhPaaT4n34efPNDBz4e6NJ1XtOW1bpmg)|

|--建表时，指定约束,drop table t3;,drop table t4;,drop table t5;,drop table t6;,CREATE TABLE t3 (    
  s1 INT,    
  s2 INT,    
  s3 INT,    
  KEY (s1),    
  CONSTRAINT C0 FOREIGN KEY (s2) REFERENCES t1(s3) ON DELETE NO ACTION ON UPDATE NO ACTION    
  ) ENGINE=InnoDB;,CREATE TABLE t4 (    
  s1 INT,    
  s2 INT,    
  s3 INT,    
  KEY (s1),    
  CONSTRAINT C1 FOREIGN KEY (s2) REFERENCES t1(s3) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE    
  ) ENGINE=InnoDB;,CREATE TABLE t5 (    
  s1 INT,    
  s2 INT,    
  s3 INT,    
  KEY (s1),    
  CONSTRAINT C2 FOREIGN KEY (s2) REFERENCES t1(s3) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE SET NULL    
  ) ENGINE=InnoDB;,CREATE TABLE t6 (    
  s1 INT,    
  s2 INT,    
  s3 INT,

  CONSTRAINT C3 FOREIGN KEY (s3) REFERENCES t2(s1)    
  ) ENGINE=InnoDB;,
